hunts.title: Rare script-interpreter parent
hunts.hypothesis: Office or script-host ancestry plus a first-observed interpreter relationship deserves review.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Approved automation, testing and software deployment.
hunts.verification_needed: Process ancestry, signed binary, operator intent, follow-on actions and actual connection evidence.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.title: Active indicator match in process telemetry
hunts.hypothesis: An active scoped indicator matched a process record. This is an investigation lead.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Test indicators, stale attribution, hash classification changes or sanctioned testing.
hunts.verification_needed: Original indicator provenance, revocation/TTL, actual file, signer and process execution context.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.title: Failure burst followed by new-device success
hunts.hypothesis: Authentication failures followed by first-observed device success warrant identity validation.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Password mistakes, device enrollment, VPN changes or helpdesk-assisted recovery.
hunts.verification_needed: Session/device authentication, MFA details, conditional-access result, user confirmation and downstream activity.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.title: Privileged identity grant outside approved change
hunts.hypothesis: A privileged grant with an explicit unapproved-change flag deserves review.
hunts.benign_alternatives: PIM activation, emergency access, approved onboarding or incorrect ticket enrichment.
hunts.verification_needed: Grant scope/expiry, authoritative approval record, grantee activity and effective role evidence.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.title: Unapproved external mailbox forwarding
hunts.hypothesis: An unapproved external forwarding rule may enable collection outside the organization.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Authorized routing, third-party case management or mailbox migration.
hunts.verification_needed: Full rule/filter/scope, actual recipients and delivery, change owner, mailbox sessions and approval.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.title: Suspicious email click followed by new-device sign-in
hunts.hypothesis: A suspicious click and new-device sign-in share verified principal context and a bounded time association.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Security-scanner clicks, legitimate travel/device change or coincidental events.
hunts.verification_needed: Human versus scanner click, URL verdict provenance, raw sign-in session, device and user corroboration.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.title: First-observed AWS AI runtime followed by sensitive data access
hunts.hypothesis: A first-observed caller/runtime relationship followed by linked sensitive access requires business-entitlement review.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Approved training pipelines, intentional delegation or a new legitimate role.
hunts.verification_needed: Service operation, selected role, effective permission/trust, runtime/workload join and sensitive-object entitlement. PassRole is not a standalone API event.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.title: Azure role grant followed by sensitive secret read
hunts.hypothesis: An explicitly unapproved privileged grant is followed by linked sensitive-secret access.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Approved deployment, emergency repair, delayed ticket synchronization or expected application bootstrap.
hunts.verification_needed: Role assignment scope/grantee, actual resource/data-plane logs, secret access and approved business purpose.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.title: Google service-account delegation followed by data read
hunts.hypothesis: An unapproved delegation and data read share the delegated identity and recorded originating principal.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Authorized build/deployment, maintenance or incorrect change-context enrichment.
hunts.verification_needed: Original delegation chain, effective account scope, Data Access configuration and authorization result; missing delegation evidence is inconclusive.
hunts.decision: candidate lead only; analyst corroboration required
hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.benign_alternatives: Authorized DaemonSet, node troubleshooting or a deliberately isolated test.
hunts.verification_needed: Audit stage/level, requested pod settings, admission decision, actual running settings and namespace owner.

hunts.title: AI retrieval or tool action outside logged policy scope
hunts.hypothesis: An application policy observation reports an operation outside approved actor/document/tool scope.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Synthetic tests, an incorrect entitlement mapping or a stale policy version.
hunts.verification_needed: Verified actor, document/chunk/tool scope, policy version and deterministic authorization result; a model label is not sufficient evidence.

hunts.title: Consumed artifact differs from approved digest
hunts.hypothesis: Observed consumed content differs from the recorded admitted artifact identity.
hunts.benign_alternatives: Authorized rollback/rebuild, incorrect approval binding or a source-record error.
hunts.verification_needed: Actual consumption digest, admission record, trusted publisher/provenance inputs and workload runtime identity. Hashes alone do not establish provenance.

hunts.threshold_scope: illustrative synthetic lab; production calibration required

hunts.verification_needed: Owner/change evidence, actual recovery configuration, surviving copies, independent audit record and restore feasibility.
